Let me think through Pete Sampras's Grand Slam record in the 20th century (1990-2000).

Pete Sampras won:
- Wimbledon: 7 times (1993-1995, 1997-2000)
- US Open: 5 times (1990, 1993, 1995-1996, 2002)
- Australian Open: 2 times (1994, 1997)
- French Open: Never won

Wait, I need to reconsider the US Open - his 2002 win was in the 21st century, so in the 20th century he won it 4 times (1990, 1993, 1995-1996).
